title: Cloud Save Architecture & Offline Progress
excerpt: How we're building cloud saves with localStorage fallback and pure time-delta offline progress calculations.

body.text: Evermarch is designed so that a player's world can keep moving without requiring a permanent connection. Progress that happens while away is calculated from the elapsed time since the last save rather than from a separate always-running process.
Cloud saves are paired with a local fallback so players can keep their progress available while the online service is unavailable or while they are playing without an account.
Keeping these systems separate lets the game preserve the same core progression rules whether a save lives locally or is backed up to the cloud.
